notes.title: Version 1.0 Patch 4
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

Welcome to version 1.0 Patch 4

Bugs Fixed

 Barkeeper will no longer turn away a customer if they're waiting on a bottle being used by another staff member
 Liquor drinkers will ALWAYS pay their tab before leaving, no matter the reason
 Changing your keybind deleted the entire keybind option, this is now fixed
 A player loaded 200 songs onto the Jukebox and nuked their game, we found the cause and it's now sorted, enjoy your unlimited playlist
 Bottles are now properly refreshed after returning to an old bar
 Fixed an issue where if you're turning the bottle and exit pouring mode at the same time it kept spinning
 Cash register will calculate your change properly if you close and reopen it
 Fixed an issue where if you placed a fridge against the bell in the 2nd bar it would delete the bell



News: The state of play

So I've got some bad news folks but I felt it was important to keep everyone aware of what's going on, our long-time investors have finally pulled funding. The full structure is Steam takes an initial 40%, from what we're left with our investors then continue to take 50% until the investment is repaid, leaving a 25%/25% split between myself and Valentin, which equates to not very much and definitely not enough to survive on unless the game happened to blow up overnight.
To make matters worse, the prospect of employment within the games industry has never been worse, fortunately Valentin is brilliant so he's received an offer but I digress! My main point is that the roadmap will be affected, but to what extent is hard to say right now. Both myself and Valentin really want to continue to make this game better and I don't want anyone thinking we'll abandon it, we 100% believe there's something special here.

So to everyone here, keep suggesting new and cool things, keep bug reporting and keep the drinks flowing, this isn't the end even if it's not quite the future we were all hoping for.

notes.title: Version 1.0 Patch 2
notes.content:
Hi everyone, so we've had the best of both extremes since launch which can be wonderful yet daunting. It's just so wonderful to have this level of support with people praising the game and making their own suggestions to how it could be even better!
Yet on the other end we see harsh criticism, the kind that makes you wince as you read/watch on. However I strongly believe that both are coming from a place of passion, therefore ignoring the 'haters' only serves to harm a game's development and purely listening to the supporters only gives half the story.
So to all the people who have spoke loudly on the positives and also to those who have shone a light on the negatives, I am very grateful to you both.

Anyway, here's the patch:

Bugs

 Bottles will no longer get stuck to employees hands and get stored in wrong places
 Pictures displayed wrong tooltips
 Removed softlock for using the cash register
 Made the fridge lights 1/4th as bright as before
 Fixed misaligned walls in bar 2 (2 walls will require repainting if you've painted them already, sorry)
 Pub names didn't get saved between patches but now it will
 Liquor specialist was locked behind level 21, this wasn't the intention and the requirement is lowered
 Liquor pouring had incorrect tooltips
 Some AI liked to do a cheeky T-pose when waiting for change, new laws have made this illegal


Balancing

 We've changed the prices on all licenses, making the earlier packages cheaper but the later ones more expensive


Feature

 We've added a new 'info' app on the in-game PC. Should you ever be confused about how the game works, information can be found there

notes.title: Pub Sim 1.0 Release
notes.content:
Well folks, this is it. Our exit from Early Access and into version 1.0.
We call it this because we want to convey that this isn't the end, that more updates and content will come of which I'll detail below. But without further ado, here's what the update brings:

Features

 The Imperium, a huge property that used to be a nightclub before 'the incident', no longer will you be scratching for space in the Hound and Hare, this marks a significant milestone in our ability to make purchasable properties and future versions will now be easier for us to make.
 Background Sim, a huge effort in optimization. When you leave a property, the game will now covert all objects into pure mathematical calculations. This means you can now own as many properties as we can deliver with no impact to performance.
 Inverted bar corners, a long requested piece of furniture which will allow you to snake your bar in any direction you so please.
 Posh bar pieces, now there are 3 tiers of bars with the last one giving a + rep for having.
 Golden rep reward, if a customer finds more than 4 things they like about your bar, it's condensed into 1 golden +rep that doubles the reward.
 Steam achievements, enjoy showing off your successes in Pub Sim, now we've got it working you can expect more in the future.
 New Save System, our old system was very prone to corruption when the game got updated, the new system saves and checks many more aspects of the game to hopefully make sure changes are properly integrated.
 Snapping Grid, this allow you do quickly and accurately place objects, no longer will you be stuck measuring the specific height of lights.
 Animated progress bar, not requested at all but I personally felt that 1.0 is a benchmark where we make sure there is no part of the game that looks 'good enough' but rather has had effort poured into it. The old bar was a remnant of the first prototype so I hope you enjoy the new one.


Bug Fixes

 Chandelier has been optimized
 Level 999999999 won't appear for brand new players
 Initial game view ruined the broken Pub surprise, camera is now fixed
 Improved interaction box for cash register
 Repairing front text now says 'repair' instead of 'expand property'
 Keybind switching is fixed
 Jukebox didn't always show the music available
 Game no longer gets pitch-black at night
 All drinks are now on the price sheet
 Barkeepers will stop undercharging customers
 Customers will move away a lot faster now if a barkeeper refuses their order
 Liquor is now charged correctly (you always made a loss if you charged less than 300%)
 Barkeepers will stop freezing players if they use your beertap at the same time
 Fixed text overlapping problems
 Money sound is now affected by volume sliders
 Players can only stand from crouching if nothing is above them, this caused big problems before


Tweaks

 Added more descriptions for the misc crates
 Fixing the Pub front makes all the doors faster and without the creakiness
 Tip jars now accumulate money rather than giving it automatically
 Added a confirmation to starting your first shift to prevent early mistakes
 Added subtle tutorial for dealing with change
 Customers will no longer ask for a similar product if you don't have one
 Added -3 for dirty windows so players are more aware they can wash them
 We've split up the licenses so you don't need to purchase everything at the same time
 Also added 'recommended capital' for each license
 Added more staff management options
 Added warning for quitting the game when it hasn't saved
 Made the player hitbox smaller
 Vastly optimized the customer and staff AI
 Liquid amounts in wine and Liquor is now more easily seen
 Loan payback is now 0.5% of the current amount instead of the initial amount
 Added 'Final Orders' so you don't need to wait for ages at 00:00 while the liquor drinkers spend another couple of hours there
 Added map markers to help lost souls find their way home
 Made Whiskey Bottles a little smaller since they overlapped everything
 Plant collision box has been severely reduced


The future
For this release we had the help of our fantastic testers:
Knightowl, KristyDiggs and Thamalo.
Who helped purely because they wanted to see Pub Sim become the best game it could be, to them myself and Valentin are incredibly grateful.
But specifically for this patch we also hired a team of professional testers to make sure this comes out as smooth as possible. If you do find any problems then please let us know and we'll work to fix it straight away.

Lastly, we did a community vote to what comes next so I'd like to present the results and plan in this order:

Today - 1.0 launch
Summer - Cooking snacks and soft drinks.
Autumn - Bathrooms, overdrinking and barfights
Winter - Fruit Machines, dodgy games and Casinos

Again thankyou to everything for supporting this game, we love to work on it and it's only because of you that we can continue to do so. We sincerely hope you enjoy this for a long time to come.

notes.title: Patch 11
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107444/986bd232608bcda0f06f12ec6eaac08f22af5471.png

Hi again everyone, I come bearing news (other than the update) and I'm excited to get stuck in.

The Future
Right now we're working towards a huge feature, the ability to purchase another property on the map and own two Pubs at the same time. I believe this will take another couple of months to get it perfect but once this is done I will consider the game out of Early Access. 

What does this mean for the game? Not much in a development sense, we'll keep digging through the most suggested features and work on the next big thing, the only reason we're calling this 'complete' is because this feature (along with the others we've implemented) pretty much encompasses the vision of what we thought this game should be.

The Present
This update comes with something else which, to my surprise, has been suggested by the existing community for some time. The game is too cheap, and while I wanted to keep the price low this also comes with expectations that the game isn't very good and is 'bargain bin' tier. So for this I'll be raising it to be in-line with other Sim games in our quality range.

The Patch
And now we come to the patch itself, this isn't the biggest one but should fix many of the gripes we've been facing since patch 10 and beyond.

Bugs fixed

 Save slot data not always updating
 Wine was drained too quickly when being drunk
 Shotglasses VFX went wild when used by staff
 Liquor drinkers didn't reward the player for each drink
 Shotglass UI is not accurate
 Storage shelves can become unusable
 Beer not draining when being drunk
 Liquor drinker rate every drink as extremely dissimilar
 Beer tap kept running if shift ended while barkeeper was pouring
 Crates would randomly be rotated 180 on load
 Spillages are now on the tables instead of the floor (customers no longer wetting themselves)
 Couldn't move chandelier after placing
 Barkeepers kept phasing through the bar
 Cleaner got stuck on one particular spiderweb
 Glasses no longer get stuck to customers legs (hopefully fixed)
 Shelves no longer contain ghost bottles
 Rarely a barkeeper didn't take money from customers
 Ultrawide monitors had a squishing issue with the in-game PC, this has finally been fixed


Features

 Added inverted options
 Added controller support
 Customers can leave puddles if it's a rainy day

notes.title: Upcoming Patch 10
notes.content:
As well as the usual bug fixes I thought it'd be nice to keep you in the loop to what's coming next, we're aiming to launch this just ahead of the Steam autumn sale.

Fluid Dynamics
We're working on making the liquids in the game look more realistic since right now it's functional but not great to look at.

Lighting Pass
We wish to make the game nicer to look at, making sure that the game has less harsh shadows especially when you expand the building.

New Game Intro
The game will start with a little more context to what's going on.

New Broken Front
New games will start with a dilapidated front, fixing it will allow a 50% increase to drink markup and gives a new short-term goal.

Tip Jars
3 tiers of tips will be added to allow you to earn a little more on the side for happy customers.

New Drink Crates
We're adding 9 more boxes for drinks, this will be to more clearly show the difference between Beers, Wines and Liquors at a glance. Then also Economic, Mid-range and Premium versions of those drink types.


Further Notes
Firstly, the property management feature is still being worked on, it won't be ready for patch 10 but I doubt it'll be too far behind it

Secondly, against my initial wishes it has been suggested from the community and internally that Pub Sim is just too cheap and people seem enthusiastic to support it further, so after the Autumn sale I will be raising the price to be more in-line with other Sim games of similar quality.

notes.title: Patch 6, Liquor? I barely know her!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107444/f9026eae6d9115343adc3e304f0418dadc8a2f0e.png

This is our first patch that contains not only bug fixes and new furnitures and paints, but also a completely reworked Liquor
system to remove the 'clog' you may have experienced after you've unlocked Spirits, making it the least liked aspect of the game.

Note: PATCH MAY LEAVE OLD SAVES BUGGED, IF YOU FACE EXCESSIVE BUGS THEN PLEASE START A NEW GAME

Now that's cleared up, here's the notes:

Liquor Rework

 Added a new staff type, Liquor Specialist, they will walk to people sat at the bar and serve them independently
 Added the barstool, just one for now, liquor drinkers will use a stool if one is available, freeing up your queue
 Drinkers who use the stool may repeat orders, if they use the cash register they will only order once


Known issue:

 Oak bar currently isn't allowing the barstool to snap


Additional Content

 Added ability to buy blank crates to more easily move stock
 Added folders to the tablet to more easily navigate our increasing library
 Added Autumn paint set as suggested by user Vivke
 You can now put back glasses onto your shelf if you accidentally took one
 Picking up objects is now shown as a bar that fills up
 New meshes for cash! We no longer have the terrible ones that didn't match up to the numbers given
 Can now take a single beer from a crate to give to the customer, however they won't like a warm beer


**Bug fixes**

 Customers no longer get stuck against wall lights
 Barkeepers now give correct Wines
 Blocked interaction with customers on specific occasions fixed
 You can now steal tasks from Barkeepers without them locking you into place
 AI could grab ALL the pint glasses, not anymore
 Customers clipping into chairs should be fixed
 Workers no longer slide outside
 Audio sliders no longer reset to 0
 Bar Manager ordered more than 10 items on the pallet, not anymore
 'Needs more change' customer bubble now disappears
 Sometimes picking up bar pieces gave a mystery white square, this is fixed
 Bank no longer allows you to exceed total debt via chink payments
 Can no longer grab drinks through the fridge wall
 Can now close door at the end even when AI are walking through it
 Corner allows snapping, special case was found where this would break
 Fridge sometimes opened weirdly and couldn't be closed properly, found and fixed
 Shot glasses no longer shows their fluid capacity outside normal range
 Placing crates under a bar would soft-lock them, we've removed the ability to place crates there
 Kegs should no longer get stuck to Stock workers

notes.title: Patch 5
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107444/986bd232608bcda0f06f12ec6eaac08f22af5471.png

This has been our longest patch in the making, we had to be sure it met better standards than our last 4.

To that end, here's the notes:

 Cleaner 4 no longer requires 2,500 rep to unlock
 Holding RMB will remove items continuously instead of a burst of 4
 Shelves will no longer claim an item is there when it isn't
 Storage will now give accurate numbers to fridge capacity
 Customers are no longer sliding like an ice rink
 Painting a wall made it so you couldn't repaint specifically the last spot, this is fixed now

 Money is collected after barkeeper bins an empty wine bottle
 Sound settings no longer reset back to 0
 Card should no longer stick to your hand
 Customers should no longer stick to their chairs
 Mouse sensitivity no longer resets to 50
 Ending a day with money on the table caused a major bug, this is fixed

notes.title: Patch 4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107444/c13bdfb4c70ebb780d48b8bff3fdd5985dcf022c.png
Patch 4

work our way through early access having all major/minor bugs sorted and then we can focus on the really cool
stuff that the community has been suggesting.

BUT, without further ado, here's Patch 4's notes:
Loan fixed, was reducing despite interest rate and daily bills being the same amount
Markup no longer resets to 100% after fresh load
Taps are totally definitely fixed now and liquid won't come out the wrong one
Boxes used to break if you clipped two together
Stock worker will no longer bin full kegs

Again if you encounter any issues or have any suggestions, feel free to let us know and I'll be sure to respond as soon as I can

 Added a way to see customer mood


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107444/813c20a74c58bd53a371ad014aa2675e30ed04b9.png

First of all we want to clean up any issues players may be encountering, then we'll be getting to work on optimizations as we know this has been an area we've lacked good progress in.

After this we have a bunch of brilliant suggestions that we want to get to work on as soon as possible, whether that's adding: cooking, bar fights, a bathroom for your patrons to vomit in, another larger premises to unlock so you can build your empire, fruit machines, drunken behaviour and more.

This may seem like a lot but I can promise that it won't take forever, however we do need support so please, please, please make sure to leave a positive review on Steam and give us as much feedback as you'd like on the Forums and on Discord.

Once again, thankyou!

notes.title: Pub Sim Demo Patch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107444/986bd232608bcda0f06f12ec6eaac08f22af5471.png


 Added Sell button
 Customers now leave their drink at the table
 Changed various texts to improve clarity
 Added undo button for painting
 Bankruptcy can now only occur AFTER the shift instead of during
 Can no longer place glasses in the fridge
 Can no longer serve pints in a shot glass
 Crabwalking customers that hold up the queue have been fixed
 Sometimes handing over a drink would place it at their feet, not anymore
 AI should no longer get trapped on the door
 AI staff no longer come in for a drink like a customer
 Furniture is now grouped in the tablet inventory and can be placed sequentially without having to open the tablet constantly
 Customers now ask if you have any similar drinks before turning them away (Economy, Mid-range, premium)
 Can no longer 'mix' drinks
 Beer taps now automatically reconnect after moving a keg
 50% chance the card sticking to the hand has been fixed, let us know if you encounter that again


Known issue:
Cash register hitbox sometimes stops working
